name: Champ Camp Great Outdoors at Brandeis University
description_short: Nature focused day camp run by Champions at Brandeis University in Waltham for ages 5 to 12, by the week, 9 to 4 with free extended hours from 7:30 to 5:30. Younger campers build forts, hunt for bugs and make nature art; older campers take on survival challenges, archery, STEM and weekly field trips.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Champ Camp Great Outdoors page, Outdoor Summer Camp 2027 for ages 5 to 12. 2027 locations list Massachusetts: Brandeis University, 415 South St., Waltham, MA 02453. Core hours 9 to 4; no fee extended hours 7:30 to 9 and 4 to 5:30. Weekly enrollment; early bird $25 off per week by May 1, 2027. No dates or prices posted. Phone and email are the national family support line. The page links a tuition assistance page for Champions programs generally. The candidate URL (/GreatOutdoors) redirects here.
